description: Gaisa telpa (INSPIRE dati) is a dataset listed in Latvian Geospatial Metadata Catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geolatvija.lv. 1. AirspaceArea 2. Lower Height Limit (LowerAltitudeLimit) 3. Upper Altitude Limit (UpperAltitudelimit). Coverage: LV. The portal shows the English title as "Airspace (INSPIRE data)" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2026-09-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/conditionsUnknown). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geolatvija.
